lifecycle.retention: Retain editable logical subject and pinned provenance; product implementation/acceptance are separate records.

body.value:
Оба экрана начального Collector-импорта обязаны использовать общий
`CollectorProjectImportHelper`; raster-style creation для initial import и
composition sync проходит через `CollectorRasterLayerHelper`. Не дублируй эту
логику обратно в Activity/Dialog: vector и штатные QGIS style items должны
получать один смешанный project order, а style layer всегда остаётся read-only.

review.value: Both initial screens share one import helper; initial/composition raster styles use one helper with mixed project order and read-only identity.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
